description: Pro reads the one-line JSON startup event that a managed core station process prints on stdout once its HTTP server is bound. Pro requires `type` to be "rigplane.runtime.started"; `baseUrl` and `runtimeUrl` to be non-empty loopback http(s) URLs (scheme http or https, matched in any case; host `localhost` in any case, a `127.x.x.x` address with each octet 0-255 and no leading zeros, or `[::1]`; an optional port; an optional tail starting with `/`, `?` or `#`); and `healthUrl`, when present, to be such a URL. `runtimeUrl` is required, not optional: Pro polls the runtime endpoint it names and verifies the rigctld listener through it on every managed start. `logPath` is read as a string or null (Core emits null when no log file is configured). `pid` is not read. The pattern covers the loopback forms a Core could plausibly emit and is otherwise narrower than Pro's own check.
